default.name: Professor Quill
default.text: Ah, {nick}! Our newest apprentice. And is that a hatchling? Splendid. {companion} already likes you.

default.name: Professor Quill
default.text: You have seen the gray fog. We call it the Hush. Where it settles, things forget. This morning the bell forgot how to ring.

default.name: Professor Quill
default.text: Six Archive Temples keep Lumeria's Sparks. Wake them, and the fog lifts. Each one hides a tool that opens the way to the next.

default.name: Professor Quill
default.text: Start with the Counting Cloister, north-west. Your Bubble Wand will pop the bubbles on the path. Off you go!

mechanical_wizard.name: Professor Quill
mechanical_wizard.text: Ah, {nick}! A Mechanical Wizard. I can hear your pockets ticking. And {companion} is ticking along!

mechanical_wizard.name: Professor Quill
mechanical_wizard.text: The gray fog is called the Hush. Where it settles, things forget. This morning my abacus forgot what comes after seven.

mechanical_wizard.name: Professor Quill
mechanical_wizard.text: Six Archive Temples keep Lumeria's Sparks. Wake them, and the fog lifts. Each hides a tool that opens the way to the next.

mechanical_wizard.name: Professor Quill
mechanical_wizard.text: Start with the Counting Cloister, north-west. A place after your own heart! Your Bubble Wand pops the bubbles on the path.

code_scriber.name: Professor Quill
code_scriber.text: Ah, {nick}! A Code Scriber. Mind the ink. And {companion} is flickering hello!

code_scriber.name: Professor Quill
code_scriber.text: The gray fog is called the Hush. Where it settles, things forget. This morning my favourite book forgot its own ending.

code_scriber.name: Professor Quill
code_scriber.text: Six Archive Temples keep Lumeria's Sparks. Wake them, and the fog lifts. Each hides a tool that opens the way to the next.

code_scriber.name: Professor Quill
code_scriber.text: Start with the Counting Cloister, north-west. Read every sign you see! Your Bubble Wand pops the bubbles on the path.

bio_alchemist.name: Professor Quill
bio_alchemist.text: Ah, {nick}! A Bio-Alchemist. You smell pleasantly of mint. And {companion} is glowing already!

bio_alchemist.name: Professor Quill
bio_alchemist.text: The gray fog is called the Hush. Where it settles, things forget. This morning the sunflowers forgot which way the sun is.

bio_alchemist.name: Professor Quill
bio_alchemist.text: Six Archive Temples keep Lumeria's Sparks. Wake them, and the fog lifts. Each hides a tool that opens the way to the next.

bio_alchemist.name: Professor Quill
bio_alchemist.text: Start with the Counting Cloister, north-west. Be gentle with whatever you find. Your Bubble Wand pops the bubbles on the path.

quantum_sage.name: Professor Quill
quantum_sage.text: Ah, {nick}! A Quantum Sage. Here one blink, there the next. And {companion} is humming an island song!

quantum_sage.name: Professor Quill
quantum_sage.text: The gray fog is called the Hush. Where it settles, things forget. This morning the map room forgot where it was.

quantum_sage.name: Professor Quill
quantum_sage.text: Six Archive Temples keep Lumeria's Sparks. Wake them, and the fog lifts. Each hides a tool that opens the way to the next.

quantum_sage.name: Professor Quill
quantum_sage.text: Start with the Counting Cloister, north-west. Every place has a story. Your Bubble Wand pops the bubbles on the path.

default.name: Professor Quill
default.text: Check your goal at the top of the screen, {nick}. And remember: a wrong answer is just a question that wants another visit.

default.name: Pim
default.text: I asked the Sparring Bot for a battle and it asked ME a question. Rude! ...I got it right though.

mechanical_wizard.name: Pim
mechanical_wizard.text: Is it true Mechanical Wizards count their sandwiches? How many have you had today? ...Wow.

code_scriber.name: Pim
code_scriber.text: Code Scribers read EVERYTHING. I saw one read a cereal box twice.

default.name: Keeper Oda
default.text: I keep the temple doors. Six doors, six tools: wand, lantern, boots, whistle, charm, compass.

default.name: Keeper Oda
default.text: If a door will not open, you have not found its tool yet. No hurry. The doors are patient.

default.name: Tinker Bram
default.text: BZZT. Apprentice {nick}! Three of my Brass Gears rolled into the Counting Cloister. Could you bring them back? I rattle without them.

default.name: Tinker Bram
default.text: One, two, three! No more rattle. Take this Gear Badge. You count as well as you tinker.

default.name: Tinker Bram's helper
default.text: A sharp mind is the best tool. Answer 5 questions right on your first try, and I will share my Sparks.

default.name: Tinker Bram's helper
default.text: Five out of five! Sharp as a brand-new gear tooth.

default.name: Scribe Lila
default.text: Oh, {nick}! The wind took three pages of my story into the Counting Cloister. Without them, the dragon never gets his hat back!

default.name: Scribe Lila
default.text: All three pages! The dragon gets his hat. Take this Ink Ribbon, story saver.

default.name: Scribe Lila's helper
default.text: Every person is a story. Go and talk with 4 people around Lumeria, then tell me what you heard.

default.name: Scribe Lila's helper
default.text: Four new stories! You listen as well as you read.

default.name: Gardener Moss
default.text: The creatures are hungry, {nick}. Could you pick 4 Spark Berries in Glimmer Meadow? Only the glowing ones.

default.name: Gardener Moss
default.text: Perfectly ripe! Here is a Leaf Pin. You have a grower's patience.

default.name: Gardener Moss's helper
default.text: Creatures trust a calm voice and a good answer. Befriend 2 of them in the meadow.

default.name: Gardener Moss's helper
default.text: Two new friends! They will love the habitat.

default.name: Guide Nori
default.text: The Hush faded my map of Lumeria, {nick}. Three pieces are still out in the corners of Glimmer Meadow. Will you find them?

default.name: Guide Nori
default.text: The map is whole again! Take this Atlas Pin. You always know the way.

default.name: Guide Nori's helper
default.text: The ghosts in the Old Wing are only lonely. Help one of them: make a friend, or set it free.

default.name: Guide Nori's helper
default.text: You were kind to someone who needed it. That is the oldest lesson there is.

default.name: Ranger Fennel
default.text: Welcome to Glimmer Meadow! Fancy a game of Critter Hide-and-Seek? Three critters hide in the bushes. Watch for the ones that rustle!

default.name: Ranger Fennel
default.text: You found all three! The critters want to play again already.
